hero.title: Our nearshore delivery center in <hl>Monterrey, Mexico</hl>

factsHeading.title: The closest thing to down the hall
factsHeading.intro: Nearshore is a claim about geography before it is a claim about staffing. These are the specifics behind it.

facts.label: Distance
facts.title: 140 miles to Texas
facts.body: Monterrey sits about 140 miles (225 km) from the Texas border, the industrial anchor of the corridor the United States and Mexico trade across under USMCA.

facts.label: Travel
facts.title: Nonstop, one to four hours
facts.body: Monterrey International Airport (MTY) has nonstop service to major US cities. An onsite workshop costs a morning of travel instead of a two-day trip on either side.

facts.label: Clock
facts.title: Central Time, all year
facts.body: The working day overlaps end to end. A question raised at 10am gets an answer before lunch rather than waiting for a handoff overnight.

facts.label: Language
facts.title: Bilingual by default
facts.body: Every engineer works in English, and Spanish is there when the room prefers it. No translation layer between the client and the people doing the work.

timeZone.title: One working day, start to finish
timeZone.body: Monterrey holds Central Standard Time (CST) year round, since Mexico stopped observing daylight saving time in 2022. US Central moves to CDT from March to November, which puts the Monterrey clock an hour behind for part of the year. The schedule absorbs it: the team works the client's business hours, so the day overlaps from the morning standup to the end of it, and nothing waits for a handoff.
bullets: Standups, sprint reviews, and steering meetings inside the client's working day
Same-day answers on blockers, not a queue that clears overnight
Aligned to the client's working day, whether that is Central, Eastern, or Mountain

talent.title: Why the engineering is <hl>here</hl>
talent.body: Monterrey is Mexico's industrial capital and one of the largest engineering talent pools in Latin America. Tecnológico de Monterrey and the Universidad Autónoma de Nuevo León graduate engineers into a city that has run manufacturing, logistics, and enterprise IT at scale for decades. That matters for data work specifically: the people here have seen real ERP estates, real shop-floor systems, and real regulatory constraints, not just tutorials.
bullets: A rigorous hiring bar, then SnowPro certification paid for and tracked
Snowflake and enterprise depth at every level, not only at the top
A committed team that stays on an engagement from scope through run

visit.title: The office is open to clients
visit.body: Meeting the engineers before signing is the fastest way to judge whether a partner is real. Visits usually pair a working session on the architecture with time to see how the team runs day to day, and travel in the other direction is just as easy: our people are on your site for discovery workshops, steering reviews, and the moments where a room beats a call.

cta.title: Put a nearshore team on your Snowflake work.
cta.subtitle: Tell us where the organization stands (migrating, scaling, or building AI) and we'll bring a certified team on your business hours to move it forward.
